snippet.title: Gears of War: Redux Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Gears of War: Redux - https://www.moddb.com/mods/gears-of-war-redux
Gears of War Redux 1.1 Update - Coming September 1st!

New Maps
New Weapons - Sawed off Shotgun, Sawed off Bayonet, Breechshot
New Launcher
New Executions
CAMPAIGN/HORDE MUTATORS!
Gears 2 Enemies in Campaign
New weapons in Campaign
G2 Lancer (all under toggles)
+ QOL / Fixes
